messages.content: Write z/OS Assembler code to implement ENQ/DEQ for resource serialization in a multitasking environment

```assembler
         TITLE 'ENQDDEQ - ENQ/DEQ RESOURCE SERIALIZATION EXAMPLE'
         PRINT NOGEN
ENQDDEQ  CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)      Save registers
         BALR  R12,0                Establish addressability
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,DYNAREA           Load area for SAVEAREA
         ST    R13,4(R0)            Chain save areas
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0               New save area pointer
         
         DEVTYPE RESOURCE=DEVICENAME Check if resource exists
         
* ENQ - ENQUEUE REQUEST FOR EXCLUSIVE RESOURCE ACCESS
         ENQ   (RESNAME,QNAME,E,8,STEP)  Request exclusive lock
*        RESNAME - Resource name (8 bytes)
*        QNAME   - Queue name (8 bytes)
*        E       - Exclusive access (X for exclusive, S for shared)
*        8       - Length of RESNAME
*        STEP    - Conflict action (STEP=routine if ENQ fails)
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check ENQ return code
         BNZ   ENQFAILED            Branch if ENQ failed
         
* CRITICAL SECTION - Resource is now locked
         USING IHADCB,R2            Map DCB
         LA    R2,MYDCB
         MVI   OPENFLG,C'Y'         Mark resource as opened
         
* PERFORM PROTECTED OPERATIONS
         LA    R3,BUFFER            Load buffer address
         LA    R4,256               Load buffer size
         
         BAS   R14,PROCESS_DATA     Call processing routine
         
* DEQ - RELEASE RESOURCE
         DEQ   (RESNAME,QNAME,8)    Release the resource lock
         LTR   R15,R15
         BNZ   DEQFAILED
         
         LA    R15,0                Set return code 0
         B     RETURN
         
ENQFAILED DS    0H
         LA    R15,8                Set error return code
         B     RETURN
         
DEQFAILED DS    0H
         LA    R15,12               Set error return code
         
RETURN   DS    0H
         L     R13,4(R13)           Restore previous save area
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)      Restore registers
         BR    R14                  Return to caller
         
PROCESS_DATA DS 0H
         STM   R14,R1,20(R13)       Save work registers
         
* PROCESS THE DATA WHILE RESOURCE IS LOCKED
         LA    R5,1                 Initialize counter
LOOP     CP    R5,=P'100'           Compare counter to 100
         BH    PROCEND              Branch if done
         
         MVC   WORKAREA,0(R3)       Move data to work area
         
         LA    R5,1(R5)             Increment counter
         LA    R3,1(R3)             Increment buffer pointer
         B     LOOP
         
PROCEND  DS    0H
         LM    R14,R1,20(R13)       Restore work registers
         BR    R14                  Return
         
RESNAME  DC    CL8'RESOURCE'       8-byte resource name
QNAME    DC    CL8'QUEUENM'        8-byte queue name
DEVICENAME DC  CL8'TAPE001'        Device name for DEVTYPE
OPENFLG  DC    C' '                Open flag
BUFFER   DC    256X'00'            Buffer area
WORKAREA DS    CL256               Work area for processing
DYNAREA  DS    18F                  Dynamic save area
         
         END   ENQDDEQ
```
Show me how to use ATTACH and DETACH for spawning subtasks in z/OS Assembler with proper synchronization

```assembler
         TITLE 'ATTACHDT - ATTACH/DETACH SUBTASK MANAGEMENT'
         PRINT NOGEN
ATTACHDT CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)      Save registers
         BALR  R12,0                Establish addressability
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,DYNAREA
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* ATTACH - CREATE AND START A SUBTASK
         ATTACH EP=SUBTASKPROG,                                         X
                ECB=SUBTASK_ECB,                                         X
                TASKLIB=TASKLIB_DSN,                                    X
                WKAREA=ATTACH_PARM
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check return code
         BNZ   ATTACHFAILED         Branch if attach failed
         
* SAVE THE TASK ID FOR LATER USE
         ST    R1,SAVED_TASK_ID     Save task identification number
         
         LA    R15,0                Clear R15
         
* WAIT FOR SUBTASK COMPLETION
* Using ECB (Event Control Block) to synchronize
         WAIT  ECB=SUBTASK_ECB      Wait for task completion
         
         L     R2,SUBTASK_ECB       Load ECB value
         TM    0(R2),X'40'          Test completion bit
         BO    TASK_COMPLETE        Branch if complete
         
         LA    R15,4                Set error code
         B     RETURN
         
TASK_COMPLETE DS 0H
         L     R3,SUBTASK_ECB+4     Load return value from ECB
         ST    R3,SUBTASK_RESULT    Store result
         
* CHECK ECB COMPLETION CODE
         L     R2,SUBTASK_ECB       Load ECB again
         TM    0(R2),X'02'          Test abnormal termination
         BO    TASK_ABNORMAL        Branch if abnormal end
         
* OPTIONAL: DETACH THE SUBTASK
         L     R1,SAVED_TASK_ID     Load task ID
         DETACH (R1)                Detach the subtask
         LTR   R15,R15
         BNZ   DETACHFAILED
         
         XR    R15,R15              Set return code 0
         B     RETURN
         
ATTACHFAILED DS 0H
         LA    R15,8                Attach failed return code
         B     RETURN
         
TASK_ABNORMAL DS 0H
         LA    R15,12               Task abnormally ended
         B     RETURN
         
DETACHFAILED DS 0H
         LA    R15,16               Detach failed return code
         
RETURN   DS    0H
         L     R13,4(R13)           Restore previous save area
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)      Restore registers
         BR    R14                  Return to caller
         
* SUBTASK PROGRAM - Simple example
SUBTASKPROG CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)
         BALR  R12,0
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,SUBTASK_SAVE
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0
         
* PERFORM WORK IN SUBTASK
         LA    R15,0                Initialize result
         LA    R3,1
SUBTASK_LOOP DS 0H
         CP    R3,=P'1000'          Loop 1000 times
         BH    SUBTASK_END
         
         A     R15,=F'1'            Accumulate in R15
         LA    R3,1(R3)
         B     SUBTASK_LOOP
         
SUBTASK_END DS 0H
* STORE RESULT AND RETURN
         L     R13,4(R13)
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)
         BR    R14                  Return to parent task
         
SAVED_TASK_ID DS F                 Task identification number
SUBTASK_ECB   DS F                  Event Control Block
SUBTASK_RESULT DS F                Result from subtask
ATTACH_PARM   DS CL100             ATTACH work area
TASKLIB_DSN   DC CL44'MY.TASKLIB.LOAD'
DYNAREA       DS 18F               Save area
SUBTASK_SAVE  DS 18F               Subtask save area
         
         END   ATTACHDT
```
Demonstrate POST and WAIT operations for inter-task communication and synchronization in z/OS Assembler

```assembler
         TITLE 'POSTWAIT - POST/WAIT SYNCHRONIZATION EXAMPLE'
         PRINT NOGEN
POSTWAIT CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)      Save registers
         BALR  R12,0                Establish addressability
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,DYNAREA
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* INITIALIZE EVENT CONTROL BLOCK (ECB)
         XC    SYNC_ECB,SYNC_ECB    Clear ECB (initial state: not posted)
         
* ATTACH PRODUCER AND CONSUMER TASKS
         ATTACH EP=PRODUCER_TASK,ECB=PROD_ECB
         ST    R1,PROD_TASKID
         
         ATTACH EP=CONSUMER_TASK,ECB=CONS_ECB  
         ST    R1,CONS_TASKID
         
* MAIN TASK: WAIT FOR PRODUCER TO COMPLETE
         WAIT  ECB=PROD_ECB         Wait until producer finishes
         
         L     R2,PROD_ECB          Check producer ECB
         TM    0(R2),X'40'          Test posted bit
         BZ    PROD_WAIT_FAILED
         
* MAIN TASK: NOW WAIT FOR CONSUMER
         WAIT  ECB=CONS_ECB         Wait for consumer completion
         
         LA    R15,0                Success return code
         B     RETURN_MAIN
         
PROD_WAIT_FAILED DS 0H
         LA    R15,4                Producer wait failed
         
RETURN_MAIN DS 0H
         L     R13,4(R13)
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)
         BR    R14
         
* PRODUCER TASK
PRODUCER_TASK CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)
         BALR  R12,0
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,PROD_SAVE
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* PRODUCE DATA
         LA    R3,DATA_QUEUE        Load queue pointer
         XR    R4,R4                Initialize counter
         
PROD_LOOP DS   0H
         CP    R4,=P'100'           Produce 100 items
         BH    PROD_COMPLETE
         
         MVI   0(R3),C'D'           Mark data as ready
         MVC   1(79,R3),ITEM_DATA   Move item data
         
         LA    R3,80(R3)            Next queue entry
         LA    R4,1(R4)             Increment counter
         
         B     PROD_LOOP
         
PROD_COMPLETE DS 0H
* POST THE ECB TO SIGNAL COMPLETION TO CONSUMER
         POST  PROD_ECB             Post ECB (wake waiting tasks)
         
         L     R13,4(R13)
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)
         BR    R14                  Return
         
* CONSUMER TASK
CONSUMER_TASK CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)
         BALR  R12,0
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,CONS_SAVE
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* WAIT FOR PRODUCER TO POST ECB
         WAIT  ECB=PROD_ECB         Wait for producer
         
* CONSUME DATA FROM QUEUE
         LA    R3,DATA_QUEUE        Load queue pointer
         XR    R4,R4                Initialize counter
         
CONS_LOOP DS   0H
         CP    R4,=P'100'           Consume 100 items
         BH    CONS_COMPLETE
         
         CLI   0(R3),C'D'           Check if data ready
         BNE   CONS_LOOP_NEXT
         
         MVC   WORKAREA,1(R3)       Process item
         MVI   0(R3),C' '           Clear item marker
         
CONS_LOOP_NEXT DS 0H
         LA    R3,80(R3)            Next queue entry
         LA    R4,1(R4)             Increment counter
         B     CONS_LOOP
         
CONS_COMPLETE DS 0H
* SIGNAL COMPLETION WITH POST
         POST  CONS_ECB             Post ECB (main task resumes)
         
         L     R13,4(R13)
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)
         BR    R14                  Return
         
* DATA AREAS
SYNC_ECB    DS    F                 Main ECB for synchronization
PROD_ECB    DS    F                 Producer completion ECB
CONS_ECB    DS    F                 Consumer completion ECB
PROD_TASKID DS    F                 Producer task ID
CONS_TASKID DS    F                 Consumer task ID
DATA_QUEUE  DS    8000X'00'        Queue for producer/consumer
ITEM_DATA   DC    CL80'SAMPLE DATA ITEM'
WORKAREA    DS    CL80              Work area
DYNAREA     DS    18F               Main save area
PROD_SAVE   DS    18F               Producer save area
CONS_SAVE   DS    18F               Consumer save area
         
         END   POSTWAIT
```
Write z/OS Assembler code demonstrating LOAD and DELETE for dynamic program loading and resource cleanup

```assembler
         TITLE 'LOADDEL - LOAD/DELETE DYNAMIC MODULE MANAGEMENT'
         PRINT NOGEN
LOADDEL  CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)      Save registers
         BALR  R12,0                Establish addressability
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,DYNAREA
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* LOAD - DYNAMICALLY LOAD A MODULE FROM LIBRARY
         LOAD  EP=DYNAMIC_MODULE    Load module by entry point name
*        Returns in R0: Entry point address of loaded module
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check load return code
         BNZ   LOAD_FAILED          Branch if load failed
         
* SAVE MODULE ENTRY POINT ADDRESS
         ST    R0,MODULE_ADDR       Save entry point address
         
* OPTIONAL: GET DCB INFORMATION FOR LOADED MODULE
         L     R2,16                Load CVT address
         L     R2,0(R2)             Load FLCCVT
         
* PREPARE PARAMETER BLOCK FOR MODULE
         LA    R3,PARM_BLOCK        Load parameter block address
         LA    R4,PARM_DATA         Load parameter data address
         ST    R4,0(R3)             Store parameter pointer
         
* CALL THE DYNAMICALLY LOADED MODULE
         L     R15,MODULE_ADDR      Load module entry point
         BALR  R14,R15              Call the module
         
         ST    R15,MODULE_RETCODE   Save module return code
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check module return code
         BNZ   MODULE_CALL_ERROR    Branch if error
         
* OPTIONAL: CALL MODULE AGAIN WITH DIFFERENT PARAMETERS
         MVC   PARM_DATA,ALT_PARM   Move alternate parameters
         
         L     R15,MODULE_ADDR      Load module entry point again
         BALR  R14,R15              Call module again
         
         LTR   R15,R15
         BNZ   MODULE_CALL_ERROR
         
* DELETE - UNLOAD MODULE AND RELEASE RESOURCES
         DELETE EP=DYNAMIC_MODULE   Delete loaded module from memory
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check delete return code
         BNZ   DELETE_FAILED        Branch if delete failed
         
* VERIFY MODULE IS UNLOADED BY ATTEMPTING LOAD
         LOAD  EP=DYNAMIC_MODULE    Try to load again
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check return code
         BZ    RELOAD_SUCCESS       Branch if successfully reloaded
         
* IF RELOAD FAILED, MODULE WAS TRULY DELETED
         LA    R15,0                Set success
         B     RETURN
         
RELOAD_SUCCESS DS 0H
* DELETE AGAIN
         DELETE EP=DYNAMIC_MODULE   Delete the reloaded module
         LA    R15,0                Set return code
         B     RETURN
         
LOAD_FAILED DS 0H
         LA    R15,8                Load failed return code
         MVC   ERROR_MSG,=CL80'LOAD operation failed'
         B     RETURN
         
MODULE_CALL_ERROR DS 0H
         LA    R15,12               Module call error return code
         MVC   ERROR_MSG,=CL80'Module execution error'
         B     RETURN
         
DELETE_FAILED DS 0H
         LA    R15,16               Delete failed return code
         MVC   ERROR_MSG,=CL80'DELETE operation failed'
         
RETURN   DS    0H
         L     R13,4(R13)           Restore previous save area
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)      Restore registers
         BR    R14                  Return to caller
         
* DATA AREAS
MODULE_ADDR    DS    F              Entry point address
MODULE_RETCODE DS    F              Return code from module
PARM_BLOCK     DS    F              Pointer to parameter data
PARM_DATA      DS    CL100          Parameter data area
ALT_PARM       DC    CL100'ALTERNATE PARAMETERS FOR MODULE'
ERROR_MSG      DS    CL80           Error message area
DYNAREA        DS    18F            Save area
         
         END   LOADDEL
```
Create a complete z/OS Assembler example combining ENQ/DEQ and LOAD/DELETE for protected module access in a database transaction scenario

```assembler
         TITLE 'DBTXN - DATABASE TRANSACTION WITH PROTECTED MODULE ACCESS'
         PRINT NOGEN
DBTXN    CSECT
         STM   R14,R12,12(R13)      Save registers
         BALR  R12,0                Establish addressability
         USING *,R12
         LA    R0,DYNAREA
         ST    R13,4(R0)
         ST    R0,8(R13)
         LR    R13,R0)
         
* STEP 1: ENQ - ACQUIRE EXCLUSIVE LOCK ON DATABASE RESOURCE
         ENQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,E,8,STEP)  Exclusive access
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check ENQ return code
         BNZ   ENQ_FAILURE          Branch if lock failed
         
         MVI   LOCK_FLAG,X'FF'      Mark resource as locked
         
* STEP 2: LOAD - DYNAMICALLY LOAD DATABASE ACCESS MODULE
         LOAD  EP=DBACCESS          Load database module
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check load return code
         BNZ   LOAD_FAILURE         Branch if load failed
         
         ST    R0,DBMOD_ADDR        Save module entry point
         
* STEP 3: PREPARE TRANSACTION PARAMETERS
         LA    R3,DB_PARAMS         Load parameter block
         LA    R4,TXN_ID            
         ST    R4,0(R3)             Store transaction ID pointer
         
         LA    R4,DB_QUERY
         ST    R4,4(R3)             Store query pointer
         
         LA    R4,DB_RESULT
         ST    R4,8(R3)             Store result buffer pointer
         
* STEP 4: CALL LOADED MODULE WITH TRANSACTION PARAMETERS
         L     R15,DBMOD_ADDR       Load module entry point
         BALR  R14,R15              Call module
         
         ST    R15,TXN_RETCODE      Save transaction result
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check return code
         BNZ   TXN_FAILURE          Branch if transaction failed
         
* STEP 5: VERIFY TRANSACTION RESULT
         L     R3,DB_RESULT         Load result buffer
         CLI   0(R3),X'01'          Check success indicator
         BNE   RESULT_ERROR         Branch if not successful
         
* STEP 6: DELETE - UNLOAD DATABASE MODULE
         DELETE EP=DBACCESS         Unload module from memory
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check delete return code
         BNZ   DELETE_FAILURE       Branch if delete failed
         
* STEP 7: DEQ - RELEASE EXCLUSIVE LOCK ON DATABASE RESOURCE
         DEQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,8)  Release lock
         
         LTR   R15,R15              Check DEQ return code
         BNZ   DEQ_FAILURE          Branch if dequeue failed
         
         MVI   LOCK_FLAG,X'00'      Mark resource as unlocked
         
* COMMIT TRANSACTION - SUCCESS
         LA    R15,0                Set return code 0 (success)
         B     RETURN
         
* ERROR HANDLING PATHS
ENQ_FAILURE DS  0H
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'ENQ failed - resource locked by another task'
         LA    R15,1                Return code 1
         B     RETURN
         
LOAD_FAILURE DS 0H
* RELEASE LOCK BEFORE RETURNING ON LOAD FAILURE
         DEQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,8)
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'LOAD failed - module not found'
         LA    R15,2                Return code 2
         B     RETURN
         
TXN_FAILURE DS  0H
* ROLLBACK - DELETE MODULE AND RELEASE LOCK
         DELETE EP=DBACCESS
         DEQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,8)
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'Transaction execution failed'
         LA    R15,3                Return code 3
         B     RETURN
         
RESULT_ERROR DS 0H
* ROLLBACK ON RESULT VERIFICATION FAILURE
         DELETE EP=DBACCESS
         DEQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,8)
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'Transaction result invalid'
         LA    R15,4                Return code 4
         B     RETURN
         
DELETE_FAILURE DS 0H
* STILL RELEASE LOCK
         DEQ   (DB_RESNAME,DB_QNAME,8)
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'DELETE failed - module cleanup incomplete'
         LA    R15,5                Return code 5
         B     RETURN
         
DEQ_FAILURE DS  0H
         MVC   STATUS_MSG,=CL80'DEQ failed - could not release lock'
         LA    R15,6                Return code 6
         
RETURN   DS    0H
         L     R13,4(R13)           Restore previous save area
         LM    R14,R12,12(R13)      Restore registers
         BR    R14                  Return to caller
         
* RESOURCE AND PARAMETER DEFINITIONS
DB_RESNAME    DC    CL8'DATABASE'    Resource name for ENQ/DEQ
DB_QNAME      DC    CL8'DBQUEUE'     Queue name for ENQ/DEQ
LOCK_FLAG     DC    X'00'            Lock status flag
DBMOD_ADDR    DS    F                Database module entry point
TXN_RETCODE   DS    F                Transaction return code
DB_PARAMS     DS    3F               Parameter block (3 pointers)
TXN_ID        DC    CL16'TXN000001'  Transaction identifier
DB_QUERY      DS    CL256            Database query statement
DB_RESULT     DS    CL256            Query result buffer
STATUS_MSG    DS    CL80             Status message area
DYNAREA       DS    18F              Save area
         
         END   DBTXN
```
